close_reason: Bumped workspace rust-version from 1.75 to 1.88 (Option A2). Verified cargo +1.88.0 check --workspace --all-features --locked clean and 96/96 tests pass. Unblocks JMAP-a2e3.
description:
Discovered while working JMAP-a2e3 (CI MSRV check). The workspace declares rust-version = "1.75" in Cargo.toml [workspace.package], but 'cargo check --workspace --all-features --locked' fails on Rust 1.75 and 1.85.

Failures observed:
  - Rust 1.75: hashbrown 0.17.0 requires Cargo feature edition2024 (stabilized in 1.85). Brought in via reqwest 0.12.28 → hyper → h2 → indexmap 2.14 → hashbrown 0.17.
  - Rust 1.85: icu_properties 2.2.0, icu_properties_data 2.2.0, icu_provider 2.2.0, idna_adapter 1.2.2 all 'requires rustc 1.86'.
  - Rust 1.88.0: builds cleanly.

So the actual MSRV is somewhere in [1.86, 1.88]. Declared MSRV "1.75" was the original choice and has never been bumped (verified via 'git log -p --all -- Cargo.toml' — only one diff: '+rust-version = "1.75"' from Cargo.toml inheritance landing). The drift is silent transitive-dep churn.

This is exactly the failure mode JMAP-a2e3 was designed to catch — but resolving it requires a policy decision agents should not make unilaterally:

OPTION A: Bump declared MSRV to actual (1.86 confirmed minimum from error messages, 1.88 confirmed working). Public-API impact — downstream consumers see this. Aligns CI with reality immediately. Requires testing the exact minimum (1.86 not installed locally; install or rely on CI to confirm).

OPTION B: Pin transitive deps to MSRV-compatible versions in workspace Cargo.toml. Targets: indexmap < 2.14 (to drop hashbrown 0.17), idna or url version that uses pre-2.2 icu_*. Cascading: indexmap is brought in by h2/hyper (reqwest 0.12.28) and wiremock 0.6.5; pinning indexmap likely forces older reqwest/hyper which may have its own problems. Risk of dependency hell.

OPTION C: Drop the declared MSRV altogether (remove rust-version line), document supported toolchains in README, accept current-stable-only policy. Simplest but loses the MSRV guarantee.

BLOCKS: JMAP-a2e3 (the CI MSRV check cannot be added at 1.75 because it would immediately fail; the right Rust version depends on the option chosen).

RECOMMENDED PATH: Option A with rust-version = "1.86" if a test on 1.86 confirms the minimum (would need rustup to install 1.86 to verify). The icu_* and hashbrown bumps reflect mainstream ecosystem direction; pinning would create maintenance burden and would likely fail at the next reqwest/hyper bump.

Source data:
  cargo tree -i hashbrown@0.17.0 --workspace
  cargo +1.75 check --workspace --all-features --locked
  cargo +1.85 check --workspace --all-features --locked
  cargo +1.88.0 check --workspace --all-features --locked
notes: Filed 2026-05-08 while investigating JMAP-a2e3. Need Mark's decision on Option A/B/C before JMAP-a2e3 can be implemented.
title: Discovery: declared MSRV 1.75 doesn't match actual MSRV (~1.86)
